title: rubia fruticosa subsp. pendula
intro: Rubia fruticosa subsp. pendula, commonly known as the Himalayan madder, is a plant species belonging to the Rubiaceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions. The plant is said to possess health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help in managing symptoms of arthritis and other inflammatory diseases. The bioactive constituents of Himalayan madder include alkaloids like rubiadin and anthraquinones, which are known for their therapeutic actions including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties.
